annotations.title: ID generator, UUID, ULID: UUID v4, UUID v7, ULID, NanoID

description: Generate unique IDs of every common kind in one call: UUID v4 (random), UUID v7 and ULID (time-ordered, sort by creation), NanoID (21 URL-safe characters) and random base62 and hex strings, up to 20 of each, from the platform's cryptographic random source; and decode the creation time hidden in a ULID or UUID v7. Use for database keys, request and trace IDs, file names or test data. Example: count=3. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

decode.description: Optional ULID or UUID to read the timestamp from
